datasets.name: NASA LOLA · South-pole DEM
datasets.note: Altimetry-derived gridded and interpolated terrain; pixel spacing is not effective resolution.

datasets.name: Wueller et al. (2026) · Table A1
datasets.note: Connecting Ridge site 001, not CR01; coordinate registration provisional.

settings.radial_sampling_mode: explicit nested distances; no uniform radial step

reproduce:
cd science
python scripts/validate_real_dem.py /path/to/DEM.tiff
python scripts/refine_horizon.py /path/to/DEM.tiff
python scripts/validate_spice.py
python scripts/visibility_demo.py
assumptions: Sphere through adopted local surface elevation with 2 m mast; no terrain relief.
2 m radial mast; adopted surface elevation from the same DEM.
Periodic linear interpolation between sampled horizon azimuths.
Finite Earth ellipsoid represented by numerical inner/outer radius enclosures.
limitations: Geometric visibility only; no power, link budget, Earth ground-station coverage, or landing-safety model.
Sampled 30-minute runs do not exclude between-sample reversals. Transition times are bracketed, not exact.
Terrain horizon is provisional; no independent real-terrain horizon validation or DEM error/effective-resolution layer.
Earth shape handled by numerical min/max-circle enclosures; no atmosphere or refraction.
Disk-area quadrature differences are deterministic numerical diagnostics, not confidence intervals.
Center reception aberration applied to finite-disk geometry; differential limb light time and relativistic bending not modeled.
